current_prompt.body:
READ the undirected graph with 12 nodes (0-11) and the given edge list
DETERMINE whether a Hamiltonian path exists in the graph
IF a Hamiltonian path exists THEN
OUTPUT the complete sequence of node identifiers representing the path
VERIFY that the path visits all 12 nodes
VERIFY that each consecutive pair in the sequence corresponds to an edge in the graph
USE a backtracking search with pruning to find the path
